sourceNote: Per-arc source. firing-range-fit: fitted to the 2026-09-02 in-game measurements in docs/firing-range-measurements.md. vacuum-fit: least-squares vacuum fit to data/weapons.json by scripts/fit-ballistics.mjs, which rewrites only arcs of that source. dragPerMeter is the quadratic drag coefficient k in a = -k |v| v; the launch angle is angleOffsetDeg + anglePerMilDeg * mil.

single.measuredFlightTimesNote: Video-timed at the firing range on 2026-09-02, muzzle flash to impact, about +-0.4 s; see docs/firing-range-measurements.md. The flight-time readout is a least-squares quadratic in mil through these five points, within 0.39 s of each, because the vacuum fit above runs 1.5 to 4.8 s short and no physical model fits the mortar. It is an empirical curve with no physics behind it.

low.sourceNote: One continuous elevation scale shared with the high arc, 0.05625 deg/mil being exactly 6400 mils to a circle. Fitted over twelve measured dials from 150 to 1380 mil plus three flight times: 19.7 m RMS, worst residual about -37 m at 150 mil, flight times within 0.35 s. Nothing below 150 mil was measured; the 35 and 100 mil dials are extrapolated.

high.sourceNote: Same fit as the low arc, on the steep side of the model's maximum-range angle. The 1380 mil row is the weakest measurement, the mean of two shots in a dial whose five repeats spread 45 m.
